messages.subject: Swap/reverse X axis
parts:
Hi,

my dataset has very small x-values (range0-1) like:
set.seed(10)
DF <- data.frame(x = exp(runif(1000, log(0.000001), log(1))),
y = rnorm(1000))


To make also differences in the small values visible I use log-scale:
ggplot(DF, aes(x, y)) + geom_point() +
scale_x_continuous(trans="log")

Now I'd like to reverse the X axis, so that 1 is located on the
left and 0 at the right (1 -----> 0). The trans="log" should still
be "on" to see the differences in the small values. Is there a
possibility to do that with ggplot2? The axis should be reversed in all
plots (I have facetted plots).


/Johannes
